alignments.note: Ordinary negative rendered by *not*. Rule 44 does not arise: that rule is for a particle whose only work is to mark the question, whereas `οὐ` carries negation the ASV writes out even though the clause is interrogative.

Inflected verb takes its interrogative auxiliary *do* and subject *ye* as rule 9 helpers, discontinuously under rule 15. Head on *distinctions* rather than *make*: rule 17's support-verb clause and rule 91's operational test, no part of *make* answering to this lexeme (compare `γνωρίζω` → *make known* heading on *known*, `εὐθύνω` → *make straight* on *straight*).
Expressed preposition realized by *among* under rule 36.
Expressed conjunction takes the English *and*; rules 88 and 98 govern only supplied junctures and do not arise.
Second-person plural verb. The subject *ye* is already spent on `διεκρίθητε` in the coordinated clause, so nothing further rides here; the *and* is `καί`'s own.
Predicate noun of `ἐγένεσθε`, standing bare. The supplied *with* is not its own — see the note on `διαλογισμῶν`.

Genitive of quality: *with* realizes the case and rides with the noun under rules 21 and 23, the Greek being anarthrous so no article stands to anchor it — as `τῇ προσευχῇ` → *by prayer* and `τοῖς ἀνθρώποις` → *unto men* are one unit on the noun. Discontinuous under rule 15, `πονηρῶν` keeping *evil*. The packet's gloss brackets *with* onto `κριταί`, which is the competing reading; rule 36's principle that the English preposition answers to what licenses it, together with rule 21's case-preposition treatment, puts it on the genitive noun instead.
Attributive adjective. Rule 58 does not arise: no determiner is supplied for the phrase, so nothing has to be assigned to the noun rather than the adjective.

review_notes: Reviewed against the contract and returned unchanged; the accepted alignment is correct at every unit, edge and head. Notes were tightened only to name the rules the competing readings turn on.
All 9 source and 13 target ids partitioned exactly once, every unit `aligned` with nonempty arrays and both heads members of their arrays (rule 3).

The one materially contested edge is *with* (t011). Rule 21 settles it: where the ASV supplies no determiner the case preposition stays with the noun, so `διαλογισμῶν` takes *with … thoughts* discontinuously under rule 15. The packet gloss's *judges [with]* is the competing reading and is recorded in that unit's note under rule 16.

Head of `διεκρίθητε` on *distinctions* rather than the light verb *make*, under rule 17's support-verb clause and rule 91's operational test. The marginal readings *are ye not divided* and *in your own mind* are not the ASV text and do not bear on the alignment.

Variant SBLGNT.JAS.2.4.v005 is underdetermined and carries no `FALLBACK EXCLUDED BY EVIDENCE` mark; its fallback is compatible with the English, so rule 97 does not apply and no textual decision was made here (rule 12).
No `unrepresented` or `added` units: every source token has English answering to it and every English token is licensed by a source token, so rules 37, 86 and 98 do not arise.
